items.text: Add Collective (Category A notarized) entry type to imagodei DNA: founder_agent_cid, charter (<=16KiB immutable), display_name (mutable), created_at_block_height, salt (16 bytes)
Add Membership (Category A notarized) entry type: person_cid, collective_cid, role: MembershipRole, sponsor_cid Option, joined_at_block_height
MembershipRole enum: Steward (authoritative) / Contributor / Observer (role derived via link kind, not separate entry)
CID-derived identity (no slugs): Collective.id over {founder, charter, block_height, salt}; Membership.id over {person, collective, role, joined_at, sponsor}
Link types: MemberOf / HasMember (role tag) / HasMembership (anchored, ordered) / StewardOf / CharterAnchor (well-known anchor for CID resolution)

Integrity validators (structural only, no get_links): charter non-empty<=16KiB, display_name<=256, salt 16 bytes, founder signature via must_get_action, update_collective changes only display_name (charter immutable), Steward role requires Some(sponsor_cid)

qahal_coordinator zome with 5 fns: create_collective (atomic founder Steward membership), update_collective (steward-gated), request_membership (Contributor/Observer self-join, Steward needs sponsor), attest_membership (steward counter-attestation), revoke_membership (steward + reason + signal)
Coordinator-side authority checks (link traversal): is-current-steward for update/attest/revoke; revoke emits ElohimContentSignal qahal:membership-revoked for projection audit log
Projection: diesel qahal_collectives + qahal_memberships tables fed by ElohimContentSignal handlers; /api/v1/collectives/{cid} read route + Viewer.collectives GraphQL resolver

VF-GraphQL mapping (Wave 3): Collective->Organization implements Agent; Membership->AgentRelationship; MembershipRole->AgentRelationshipRole labels; extension fields for salt/sponsor/joined-at; lossy VF->qahal only
Sweettest coverage for entry types + link kinds + integrity validators (substrate-first discipline)

Deferred open questions: quorum/threshold-N-of-M steward attestation; charter mutability (Norm spec); collective inheritance (HasParent/HasChild); access policy (open/invitation/application); cross-DNA placement; stewardship-handoff on key recovery (MembershipRenewal)
